description: We are the Planetary Innovation Agency, a team driven by innovation, curiosity, and real-world impact. Climate change and food security are urgent global crises that affect communities everywhere. As shifting weather patterns, severe droughts, and soil degradation threaten crop yields around the world, we are harnessing NASA space data to build smart, adaptable tools that help farmers thrive.
